lines.text: Wait! Why Goosebumps Pop Up During Awesome Music!
Most kids guess totally wrong about what causes goosebumps!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Tiny muscles under each hair tighten from cold air or big.
excitement, a leftover reflex from fluffy mammals puffing up fur for warmth.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Tiny Hair Muscles!
